Second-pack IDs must be disjoint from the first pack in the same completed epoch; IDs are current bindings, not creation identities. Independent two-sample native censuses, host-only seven-HP damage and per-ID native client positive-to-zero death logs establish application for both packs. Final fresh empty hashes/census supplement the original clear assertion. Battle byte/controller counts do not prove barriers, native producer completeness or general spawn authority. Historical201456 supports the type/count shape. Offline controls pass; live run20261003-005101 failed at the first host census helper's CreateProcess, before damage, with a matching Defender command-line detection. This fixture has not passed live.
